name: IT setup helper
description: Tracks your device and system access, and explains what happens on your first login. Checks your requests in ServiceNow.

intents.answer: Your device request is open in ServiceNow. Devices are usually delivered three to five working days before your start date, and you will get a tracking link by email.

examples: How do I log in on my first day?
How do I set up my account?
intents.answer: On your first morning, your Line Manager gives you a one-time code. Use it to sign in and choose your own password. IT will never ask you for your password.

examples: How do I get access to a system?
I need access to a tool
intents.answer: Access for your role is requested for you before you start. If something is missing, ask your Line Manager to raise a request in ServiceNow.
